title: A new look for GoAskSam
lines: Find, Market Check and Sell each open on one search box. Type or speak what you want.
Find shows three cars at auction right now, with what each sold for before or what cars like it sell for.
Market Check and Sell each show a real example, so you can see what you get before you search.
Every page shares the same header and footer, and reads better on a phone.

title: Auction history
lines: Every car Sam has seen sell has its own page, grouped by make and model.

title: Modified or original
lines: When a car's sales mix modified and original cars, Market Check lets you see each on its own.

text: Find has two new sorts. Furthest below the range puts the cars with the biggest gap between the bid and what they sell for first. Closest to me asks for your zip once and orders by distance. Both carry through Show more.
thanks: Thanks Francis for asking for both.

text: On a Find card for a car whose sales split by mileage, the box now shows the band nearest your car's miles with its range, and See the sales lets you pick any band, including ones with too few sales for a range.

Market Check now shows the closest sales to your car, matched on mileage, under the range. The page also states the mileage the range was computed at. A VIN lookup skips the trim question when the VIN already says the trim.
Show 24 more on Find now loads the next batch in one click.
The Ford Capri and Mercury Capri now find each other, and a bare model name fills in from the badge.
The sales list in the Find card popup is back. It had stopped showing when the second read failed; it now falls back to the stored sales and says when it is still reading.
Every Find card now has the same shape: a label line, the figures, and one line below. No card text is cut off.
Type a gearbox or engine, like 6-speed or V8, and Sam narrows the sales to match.
Pre-war bodies are their own markets: a Roadster, a Phaeton and a Speedster are priced apart.
Ask about a model with no year, like Audi RS6, and Sam asks which generation first.
Find cards say where the bidding sits against the range, with the time left.
Every range now shows the lowest and highest sale beside it, so you can see the whole spread at a glance.
GoAskSam is open. Ask about any car by typing or speaking, on Find, Market Check and Sell.
